title: Alchemically Transferable Parameters for Variational Quantum Eigensolvers
abstract: arXiv:2611.11445v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Machine-learned circuit parameters could remove one of the main bottlenecks of variational quantum eigensolvers: the classical optimization loop, with its typical barren plateaus, local minima, and costly energy and gradient evaluations, is replaced by a direct prediction. Prior work showed that machine-learning models paired with a structured circuit design can transfer across system size and structure within hydrogenic systems. The next step: Extending them to organic molecules would seem to require re-training on use-case-specific training sets. In this work, we show that this is not necessary by establishing an alchemical approach. A geometric projection places surrogate hydrogen atoms along the bond directions of the target molecule and so maps its local bonding environment onto small hydrogenic fragments. Existing hydrogenic solvers can then be reused as they are. The only new quantity is a single projection radius per bond type,

translated_title: 变分量子本征求解器的炼金术可迁移参数
translated_abstract: 机器学习电路参数可以消除变分量子本征求解器（VQE）的一个主要瓶颈：经典优化循环——其典型的贫瘠高原、局部极小值以及昂贵的能量和梯度评估——将被直接预测所取代。先前的工作表明，机器学习模型与结构化电路设计相结合，可以在氢基体系内实现跨系统尺寸和结构的参数迁移。下一步：将该方法扩展到有机分子，似乎需要在特定用例的训练集上重新训练。在这项工作中，我们通过建立一种炼金术方法证明这是不必要的。通过几何投影，沿目标分子的键方向放置替代氢原子，从而将其局部键合环境映射到小的氢基片段上。如此一来，现有的氢基体系求解器可以直接复用。唯一需要引入的新量是每种键类型对应的一个投影半径。
tldr: 该论文提出一种“炼金术”几何投影方法，将有机分子的局部键合环境映射为替代氢基片段，使机器学习模型无需针对有机分子重新训练，即可直接预测变分量子本征求解器所需的电路参数。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an alchemical geometric projection that maps the local bonding environments of organic molecules onto surrogate hydrogenic fragments, enabling machine-learned VQE circuit parameters to transfer to organic molecules without case-specific retraining.
